title: Hello World FastAPI
instruction: Create a FastAPI app with a single GET endpoint at the root `/` that returns `{"message": "Hello, FastAPI!"}`.
starter_code:
from fastapi import FastAPI

app = FastAPI()

# Your code here
test_suite:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_returns_hello_message():
    client = TestClient(exercise.app)
    response = client.get("/")
    assert response.status_code == 200
    data = response.json()
    assert data == {"message": "Hello, FastAPI!"}

def test_returns_json():
    client = TestClient(exercise.app)
    response = client.get("/")
    assert response.headers["content-type"].startswith("application/json")
